description: Get a brand's Parfumo page: its description and the paginated list of its perfumes. Use to browse everything a house has released. Returns the brand (id, name, URL) and perfumes with id, year and rating.

brand.description: Brand identifier: the brand `id` returned by other tools (e.g. "Dior"), a brand name, or its Parfumo URL.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor: the `next_cursor` of the previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of perfumes to return (default 25, maximum 100).

name: parfumo_get_brand

EntityRef.description: Reference to a brand, perfumer or fragrance note.

numeric_id.description: Numeric Parfumo identifier (b_id, pf_id or note id) when the page exposes it.

PerfumeSummary.description: A perfume as it appears in a listing (search, brand, ranking, similar).

concentration.description: Concentration or edition label shown next to the name (e.g. `Eau de Parfum`).

id.description: Stable identifier: `Brand/Perfume` URL slug, usable with every perfume tool.

p_id.description: Numeric Parfumo perfume id when the listing exposes it.

rank.description: Position in the ranking, when the listing is ranked.

rating.description: Average scent rating out of 10, when shown.

rating_count.description: Number of ratings behind `rating`, when shown.

reviews_count.description: Number of long reviews, when shown.

trend_count.description: Counter shown by trend rankings (collection adds, wishes or wears over the last 30 days).

url.description: Absolute Parfumo URL of the perfume page.

categories.description: For a note: the categories it belongs to.

country.description: Country of the brand or perfumer, when the page states it.

entity.description: The brand, perfumer or note: stable id, name and Parfumo URL.

founded.description: Founding year of a brand, when the page states it.

is_category.description: For a note: true when it is a category grouping several notes.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the following perfumes. Absent when there is nothing more.

perfumes.description: Perfumes of this brand, perfumer or note.

total_items.description: Total number of perfumes listed on Parfumo, when the site states it.

warnings.description: Non-fatal problems: optional parts that could not be loaded (for example the country).
